title: Ethosuximide in WOREE
summary: In one mouse study, ethosuximide pretreatment lowered PTZ-provoked seizure scores. The result leaves WWOX specificity, spontaneous seizure control and benefit in children with WWOX-DEE unestablished.
evidence: Cheng et al. reported lower PTZ-provoked seizure scores in Wwox-null mice (Figure 7B). LEGEND’s re-reading of the group means found that most separation occurred late. Individual trajectories were unavailable.
Clinical evidence in childhood absence epilepsy concerns a different seizure syndrome.
Oliver et al. list ethosuximide exposure in one published WWOX-DEE series participant with multiple ASMs tried. An independently attributable outcome was unavailable.
limits: The mouse result leaves effects on spontaneous seizures, development and benefit in WWOX-DEE unresolved.
Angelman and DEE-SWAS results use distinct outcomes and do not establish a WOREE response rate or a scalp phase–amplitude coupling threshold.

inference: The result supports an effect on induced seizures in this mouse model. Baseline differences and low scores in comparator groups limit interpretation of the apparent genotype specificity.
hypothesis: Ethosuximide could have a different effect in Wwox-deficient animals. The data leave open both a general antiseizure effect and the identity of any channel mediating the response.
experiment: Compare treated and untreated groups across genotypes at the same age. Measure the treatment-by-genotype interaction and whether any effect extends to spontaneous seizures.

In juvenile Wwox cortical slices, compare time-matched vehicle, ethosuximide and a native-engaged CaV3 reference. Measure voltage-matched rebound, first recruitment, sustained firing and spontaneous initiation and spread separately.

chapters.takeaway: LEGEND re-extracted the curves rather than treating the figure’s significance marks as evidence of a treatment-by-genotype interaction.

sections.label: Data / Evidence
paragraphs: The values are approximate extractions of group means, expressed as PTZ alone minus PTZ plus ethosuximide. The two raster versions of the same figure agreed on the main pattern. They are two readings of one experiment. Some wild-type and heterozygous markers overlapped.

sections.label: Inference
paragraphs: Minutes from a single animal are correlated. Using alternative dependence assumptions, the estimated standard error of the late gap spans about 0.14–0.72 stage. The group curves cannot establish the animal-level uncertainty. Wild-type and heterozygote groups also began nearer the scale floor.

sections.label: Comparator
paragraphs: Lithium reduced seizure scores in wild-type mice as well as the two other genotypes in Figure 7D. That comparison illustrates why a larger difference in null animals with higher baseline scores does not establish specificity.

chapters.title: Exposure and competing mechanisms
chapters.takeaway: The lab explored whether concentrations in the young mouse could reach a pharmacologically informative range. Two routes yielded bounds; neither supplied a juvenile measurement.

rows: Straddles the lower T-current benchmark and remains below the higher reading.
Above the lower benchmark in this scenario; the adult anchor is already at or above a simple mass-balance ceiling.
Disfavoured unit interpretation. It dominates the upper tail and should not be read as equally credible.

sections.label: Data / Evidence
paragraphs: The source audit did not recover a juvenile concentration in the required preparation. The reported T-current potency benchmarks around 0.6 and 5 mM differ by about eightfold and come from different assays. Four WWOX-deficient transcript datasets did not supply convergent, direct thalamic current evidence.

sections.label: Inference
paragraphs: The numerical ranges are corners of assumption sets using adult anchoring, clearance, brain distribution and volume. They are not confidence intervals, measured exposures or estimates of human exposure. The precise Cheng PTZ test age remained unresolved in the reviewed passages.

sections.label: Hypothesis
paragraphs: A T-type current effect may be part of the response. Persistent sodium current and other effects remain competing explanations. An effect in a genotype does not identify CaV3.1, CaV3.2 or CaV3.3.

chapters.title: Next experiment and limits
chapters.takeaway: The discriminating question is whether the effect follows measured exposure, genotype or the seizure assay. The existing figure cannot separate those factors.

Treatment by genotype on per-animal data
Is the response dependent on Wwox loss?
Compare baseline conditions and distinguish an interaction from significance in a single arm.
Does an effect extend beyond the PTZ challenge?
A PTZ score can change because seizure threshold or induction dynamics change.

sections.label: Experiment
paragraphs: A research comparison would combine exposure measurement with age-matched genotype controls and an interpretable baseline. Keep score trajectories and animal-level summaries. A separate mechanistic comparator would be needed wherever a specific T-type channel is claimed.

sections.label: Limits for WOREE
paragraphs: The clinical trial in childhood absence epilepsy addresses a different syndrome. The reviewed evidence leaves benefit on spontaneous WOREE seizures, development, and safety in the relevant infancy context unestablished.

sections.label: Evidence
paragraphs: The Cheng stage ≥3 effect is bounded at +11.1 to +51.7 percentage points at primary graphical tolerance and −2.2 to +55.6 at twice that tolerance. These are compatible mouse-minute bounds, not intervals for individual responders.

sections.label: Inference
paragraphs: Baseline scalp N2 coupling in a 20-child DEE-SWAS series is a different measurement from PAC within a burst in juvenile Wwox cortex. Synthetic sharp transients can leave residual coupling after subtraction of a phase-aligned mean waveform. Neither comparison supplies a validated WOREE marker.

sections.label: Discriminating experiment
paragraphs: Measure native CaV3 engagement and determine whether initiation falls while recruitment and sustained firing are preserved. A drug-specific shortening of ongoing bursts redirects the inquiry to maintenance and competing currents. Keep developmental and functional myelin outcomes separate.
